description: This PHP class file defines a 'Component' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Vue' namespace. The class models a Vue.js component with properties for its name and props, and provides methods to manipulate these properties. It is likely used as part of a larger system for rendering or managing Vue components within the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a Vue.js component with a name and properties (props). Provides methods to get, set, and add props and name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Component instance with a specified name and optional array of props.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the component.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the component.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Retrieves the array of properties (props) associated with the component.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Sets the array of properties (props) for the component.

methods.name: addProp
methods.description: Adds a new Prop object to the component's props array.
